issues.detail: Hebrew 'עֲשֶׂרֶת כֶּסֶף לַיָּמִים' means 'ten pieces of silver per year' (literally 'ten of silver for the days/years'), but Chinese renders '每年給你十塊銀子的價值' ('the value of ten pieces of silver each year'), adding '的價值' (the value of) which is not in the Hebrew and could imply a different amount.
